response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering and distributed systems expertise, with notable contributions to event-driven platforms and AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq. However, his lack of direct fintech, multi-agent AI production experience, and executive leadership in regulated environments significantly limits his fit for this role. His recent AI-agent work is promising but appears to be in early stages relative to the job's requirements.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed systems expertise (event streaming, microservices, real-time systems)
Recent hands-on contribution to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP, agentic workflows)
Proven track record scaling engineering teams and setting up CI/CD, observability, and dev-ops infrastructure
concerns: No direct fintech or agentic AI production experience in regulated, high-stakes commercial environments
Lacks documented experience with credit-risk systems, real-time inference, or financial compliance requirements
No evidence of leading teams of 10+ people or scaling to 30+ in a high-growth venture-backed setting
